title: Sandhyavandanam — study edition and questions & answers

work.title: Sandhyāvandanam (Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda, Āpastamba sūtra, Smārta), morning, midday and evening services

attribution.traditionalLocation: The Vedic mantras: Taittirīya Saṃhitā, Brāhmaṇa and Āraṇyaka (the Mahānārāyaṇa Upaniṣad, TA 10); the order of the rite and its other texts: the Āpastamba prayoga tradition

sources.label: Taittirīya Saṃhitā (pañcāśat and vākya texts), Taittirīya Āraṇyaka (muralīdhara and gaṇeśvara texts) and Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa (Drāviḍa text and muralīdhara), with svara — github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: The base texts of the Vedic mantras in /sandhyavandanam/edition/ (those not in the Mahānārāyaṇa); every unit cut by scripts/prayoga/import.py and proven by scripts/prayoga/check.py, every difference of the second text classified.

sources.label: The Sandhyāvandana prayoga of the Mylapore Veda Adhyayana Sabhā (publisher A. Subbaraman), as transcribed in github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH (taittirIyam/sUtram/ApastambaH/gRhyam/paddhatiH/mailApura-vedAdhyayana-sabhA)
sources.note: Witness M: the base for the order of the rite and for the texts only it has.

sources.label: Sandhyavandanam.tex, github.com/stotrasamhita/vedamantra-book (mantras/)
sources.note: Witness S: the base for the texts both prayogas have; every difference classified.

sources.label: Sāyaṇa and Bhaṭṭa Bhāskara on the Taittirīya Saṃhitā, Brāhmaṇa and Āraṇyaka, via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: Every Sanskrit quotation in the edition is checked against the named commentary on the passage.

sources.label: The Ṛgveda parallels: GRETIL (Aufrecht 1877), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: Printed beside the Taittirīya text; a different recension.

sources.label: Sandhyavandanam Answers.pdf
sources.note: Reference for the questions & answers page. Its own origin is not recorded.

sources.label: Sandhyavandanam_A_Forgotten_Science.pdf
sources.note: Reference for the questions & answers page. Its own origin is not recorded.

translation.note: The English translations and analysis of the study edition were prepared for PaddySpeaks, machine-checked and awaiting review by a Sanskrit scholar. The meanings on the questions & answers page were prepared for PaddySpeaks; the source files do not record a separate translator.

verification.method: scripts/prayoga/check.py (Validate Content): every Vedic unit equals its source text apart from logged corrections; every text of the rite equals its base prayoga; every difference of the other witness classified; every padaccheda rejoined by sandhi; every commentator quotation found in that commentator.

statusNote: The study edition (/sandhyavandanam/edition/) records its sources text by text and is machine-checked against them. The questions & answers page does not record where its text was taken from.
